name: – § 48 – Am 17
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 48. Notes the adoption of the binding EU 2040 climate target set by the amending act to the European Climate Law; underlines that all EU policies need to be aligned with the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality and with full respect for the energy mix of the Member States;
